markup.message: invalid has been removed from <lt-field>. The field is invalid when the error text, .lt-error-text, is visible, or when the server has written aria-invalid on the control. In Datastar: data-attr:hidden="!$invalid" on the error text.
required-marker has been removed from <lt-field>. The required marker is data-required on <label>, and then shows without JavaScript too.
control-id has been removed from <lt-field>. Write id on the control and for on the label in the template. The component never writes an id on the control.
